meta.note: Counts are from a weighted sample (1-3 star and longer reviews over-sampled), not the full review stream.

themes.name: Inaccurate or unreliable answers
themes.description: Wrong or vague information, hallucinations, flattery over correctness, ignoring instructions, misunderstanding questions, and declining quality over time.

themes.name: Learning, study help and personal companionship
themes.description: Users value it as a tutor for homework, exam prep and language learning, and as a friend, mentor or emotional support through voice and memory.

themes.name: Usage limits and paywall frustration
themes.description: Complaints about free-tier caps on images, uploads, voice and messages, quick lockouts, forced upgrades, and limits hitting even paying subscribers.

themes.name: Image generation and photo editing
themes.description: Feedback on creating and editing pictures, both praise for the results and complaints about ignored details, unrequested changes, blocked prompts and low image limits.

themes.name: Bugs, account and subscription issues
themes.description: Technical problems such as lost chat history, login failures, send errors, update problems, Work mode default, account switching or deletion, and billing or subscription mismatches.

fee_issue.description: Free users hit chat, image, photo-upload and time caps and are told to buy Plus/premium to keep using the app; chats get paused or blocked after a few messages.

other_categories.name: Paid plans still limited or poor value
other_categories.description: Paying subscribers (Plus, Go, Pro) still hit usage, image or time limits, ads or degraded quality, and feel the price is not worth it.

other_categories.name: Price too high / unaffordable
other_categories.description: Subscription cost (about Rs 499/month, $20) is too expensive for students and middle-class or poor users, who ask for lower prices or a free student tier.

other_categories.name: Payment taken but plan not activated or payment fails
other_categories.description: Users were charged (e.g. Rs 399 Go, Plus) but the plan stays inactive or shows 'upgrade'; UPI, promo-code and free-trial payments are rejected or 'not approved'.

other_categories.name: Cancellation and unwanted recurring charges
other_categories.description: Users report being charged after cancelling, being unable to cancel in-app or to find the renewal date, and nagging upgrade reminders.
